text: …in the mansion of the essence of the nonconceptual dharmadhātu, surpassing all the three realms, he dwelt together with a great saṅgha of monks and a great assembly of bodhisattvas, namely: the bodhisattva mahāsattvas Nonconceptual, Nonconceptual Light, Nonconceptual Moon, Nonconceptual Hero, Nonconceptual Skilled in Teaching the Dharma, Nonconceptual Nature, Nonconceptual…
